name: Credits / Tokens
tagline: A virtual currency layer that mediates between real money and in-app spending.
desc: Credits abstract the real cost of individual actions, making it easier to spend without feeling each transaction. The token layer also creates a second economy the product can influence through events, rewards, and bonuses, without touching core subscription pricing.
principle: Currency abstraction reduces spending friction. The user spends tokens, not money, which makes the decision feel lighter.
warn: Credit systems with opaque pricing erode trust over time. Transparency in the token-to-value relationship, even if it makes spending feel more expensive, builds long-term trust.
variants: Weekly free allowance with paid top-up
lifecycle: Effective across all lifecycle stages once established.
